messages:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: prod.gateway.v1 generate endpoint — 5xx spike (rate 18%), backend timeouts increasing, queue_depth on scheduler pool 'batcher-main' = 420 (baseline 12). Auto-escalation threshold hit. Paging oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. seeing high HEAD-OF-LINE on batcher-main, lots of long-running token streams stuck in prefill.

maya_sre: confirming — gateway-cpu normal, but scheduler-pod logs show repeated 'AcquireBatch timeout' and many requests stuck in queue for >30s.

alice_oncall: any recent deploys? deploy-bot: deploy "model-reorder-2026-03" rolled out to batcher-main at 2680007400 (20m ago).

ben_ml: that rollout changed kv-cache prefetch and also changed batch size heuristics. Suspect new batching heuristics are oversubscribing bins.

jordan_prodeng: rolling back feels reasonable as mitigation. Can we divert traffic to the fallback model pool? We have compatible variant 'gptx-small' in region-us-west.

alice_oncall: initiating mitigation steps, listing them: 1) open canary route to fallback 2) evict long-running requests from head 3) scale batcher-main down/up? 4) rollback deploy if needed.

maya_sre: doing step 1 now — switching traffic for /v1/generate -> route fallback (low-latency override). Command:
```
console route set /v1/generate --pool=gptx-small-usw --percent=30 --force
```

maya_sre: route change applied, 30% traffic to fallback. Monitoring.

alice_oncall: step 2: evicting requests > 20s from batcher-main to reduce hol blocking. Using admin evict API.

alice_oncall: sudo:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.local/admin/evict -d '{"pool":"batcher-main","age_gt_s":20}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

alerts-bot: NOTE: evict call queued, 128 requests targeted.

ben_ml: evictions started; expect brief surge of 5xx from evicted requests but reduces queue. Prep CS for customer messages.

kate_cs: pulling impacted customer list now, will draft note. Which customers hit highest error rates?

alice_oncall: quick query:
```
select customer_id, count(*) from requests
where ts > now()-60m and status >=500 and route='/v1/generate'
group by customer_id order by count desc limit 20;
```

alice_oncall: top hits: cust_acme (124 errors), cust_zenpay (87), cust_borealis (34).

kate_cs: drafting message to those three, ETA 10m.

maya_sre: queue depth down to 40, 5xx down to 6% from 18%. p50 latency still elevated but trending down.

jordan_prodeng: good. Ben, can you validate whether the new batch heuristic mis-classified streaming vs non-streaming requests? That would explain HOL.

ben_ml: looking at logs; yes, heuristics put streaming sessions into the same batch window as short completion requests; they don't preempt. Patch prepared to add 'streaming' tag to separate bin. I can push a targeted config change to batcher-main without full model rollback.

alice_oncall: prefer config change over full rollback if safe. Maya, hold rollback for now. Let's push the config to isolate streaming.

maya_sre: applying config update to batcher-main (canary 10%):
```
kubectl apply -f batcher-config-streaming-isolate.yaml --namespace=infra-prod
```

maya_sre: canary looks good at 10% — no new 5xx in that slice. Increasing to 60%.

alerts-bot: p50 latency back to baseline, 5xx at 2.8%, queue_depth stable at 8.

alice_oncall: great. Ben — follow up with a formal change to make this permanent. Jordan — let's keep the fallback route active at 20% for the next 30m while we watch.

jordan_prodeng: noted, I'm updating runbook to add explicit checks for streaming binning for future rollouts.

kate_cs: messages sent to Acme and Zenpay support contacts with incident note + ETA. Borealis on the small list but notified. I'll update if any replies.

deploy-bot: deploy "model-reorder-2026-03" flagged for rollback if 5xx > 5% for more than 15m.

alice_oncall: monitoring for 30 minutes before closing. Initiating postmortem checklist entry: collect batcher logs, sample requests for tracing, snapshot config, timeline.

maya_sre: collecting logs and uploading to /incidents/artifacts/2680012345/logs.tar.gz

ben_ml: I'll open a PR with config fix + test harness to prevent mixing streaming requests across bins.

alice_oncall: handoff to night oncall @maya_sre in 25m. Leaving this thread pinned. If paging threshold hit again, escal to eng-leads.

maya_sre: acknowledged, oncall takeover at 2680015300. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

alerts-bot: RECOVERY: 5xx rate stable below SLO, queue_depth under threshold. Incident downgraded to monitoring. "incident_severity": "page-resolved".
